notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (requests + bs4/lxml) succeeded for all pages - Shopify store, SSR HTML fully populated, no JS-rendering block needed, no escalation to Playwright/Chrome required. robots.txt checked first (User-agent: * / Allow: / with only transactional paths disallowed - none of the collection URLs used are blocked). TREE: union of mega-menu (parsed from homepage header nav links) + sitemap_collections_1.xml (331 collection URLs) + each page's own on-page link set. Mega-menu top levels are Furniture and Decor, plus a separate Storage node (Media Storage, Cabinets). Confirmed every category page in this batch carries the identical global mega-menu link set (no page-specific sub-nav strip exists on this site) via direct comparison of link sets across pillows/rugs/bedding/tabletop/storage pages - so no additional subcategory nodes were hidden per-page. QTY: exact 'N products' text rendered directly above the product grid on each collection page (Shopify theme's product-count element), confirmed against canonical URL and H1 match on every leaf. EXCLUDED: Tabletop (rendered 749 products, Product Type facet breakdown shows Material Type Fabric = only 5 of 749 and Product Type 'Tabletop' dominated by dinnerware/glass/ceramic/metal tableware - primary product type is Kitchen & Dining / decorative tabletop goods, not textile - out of scope for both this task's categories). Crypton Upholstery (528 products, Product Type facet shows Accent Chairs/Beds/Sofas/Sectionals/Dining Chairs etc - this is a material-filter collection of FURNITURE items, not a fabric-by-the-yard textile product; also not linked from mega-menu). Fabrics, Custom Upholstery Fabric, Crypton Fabric collections found only in sitemap (not in mega-menu or any category page's own nav) and show 0-1 products each - dead/legacy collections, not real navigable category nodes, excluded. Loloi Rugs / Feizy Rugs / Surya Rugs (sitemap-only vendor filter pages, not linked from the Rugs page or mega-menu - duplicate subsets of the main Rugs collection by brand, not distinct category nodes) - excluded. Bookcases + Shelves, Buffets + Sideboards, Dressers + Chests all appear on the storage-categories landing page's 'Shop by Category' tile row, but the SITE'S PRIMARY global mega-menu explicitly places them under Office Furniture / Dining Room Furniture / Bedroom Furniture respectively - per storage.md Sec21 'if the website explicitly places the product inside a Furniture category, prefer Furniture', these are excluded from Storage (they belong to the already-validated Furniture.xlsx, not touched here). Media Storage and Cabinets are the only two nodes the mega-menu itself places under its dedicated top-level 'Storage' node (confirmed by nav parse: storage-categories -> media-storage, cabinets appear consecutively as the Storage node's children in the raw header link order) and their own Product Type facets are dominated by their own type (Media Storage 211/220, Cabinets 388/396) confirming genuine storage furniture/organization primary purpose - included as Storage, HIGH confidence. best-sellers-storage, storage-categories itself (no product total displayed - pure landing/hub page) excluded per parent-category-url-rule since valid Storage subcategories (Media Storage, Cabinets) exist; storage-categories retained only as the is_group parent row. No curtains, bath/kitchen textiles, table linens, storage boxes/baskets/bags/organizers/laundry/shoe/toy storage were found anywhere in the sitemap or mega-menu (keyword sweep of all 331 sitemap collection slugs for curtain/sheet/blanket/throw/towel/napkin/placemat/tablecloth/runner/drape/duvet/quilt/comforter/sham/linen/basket/bin/box/organiz/rack/bag confirmed only storage-categories/media-storage/bookcases-shelves/cabinets/best-sellers-storage/room-ideas-dining-room-throw-a-curve matched, all already accounted for above). Bedding, Rugs, Pillows are direct top-level Decor mega-menu children with no dedicated 'Textile' parent node on the site (Decor mixes textile and non-textile siblings such as Art, Wall Decor, Mirrors, Lighting, Home Fragrance, Plants) so no artificial Decor/Textile grouping row was fabricated - each is emitted as a flat top-level leaf per the parent-category-url-rule (no subcategories exist under any of the three, each page's own link set matches the global nav exactly with zero page-specific children).
